incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark, swirling storm cloud dominates the sky above a tree line and a small cluster of houses, with lighter smoke or cloud plumes visible on the right.

observations.description: Large, dark, billowing cloud formation in the sky, suggesting a severe weather system or wildfire.
Dark tree line at the horizon, with some scattered trees closer to the houses.
A small house or cluster of buildings with a sloped roof on the right side of the image.
Lighter, hazy plumes of smoke or cloud on the right side of the image, near the house.
